verified_facts.text: Villa Dubrovnik is perched on a cliff above the Adriatic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on a cliff with its distinctive architecture, Hotel Villa Dubrovnik embodies the essence of its city.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers views of the island of Lokrum and Dubrovnik's Old Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering its guests a wonderful view of the island of Lokrum and the Old Town.

verified_facts.text: The building was designed in 1961 by architect Mladen Frka as a residence for members of political elites in Dubrovnik's Sveti Jakov area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Villa Dubrovnik was designed in 1961 as a residential building for members of political elites in the prestigious location of Dubrovnik Sveti Jakov area by architect Mladen Frka.

verified_facts.text: In 1963 the building became an annex to Hotel Argentina.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its function was changed in 1963 when it became an annex to Hotel Argentina

verified_facts.text: In 2003, architects Boris Fiolic and Mira Tadej redesigned the building on its cliff site in a protected landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2003, architects Boris Fiolić and Mira Tadej redesigned the building, facing the challenge of constructing the complex on a cliff in a protected landscape environment.

verified_facts.text: During the winter of 2024 the hotel underwent a complete renovation by Brazilian studio Studio Arthur Casas.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the winter of 2024, the hotel underwent another complete renovation by the internationally recognized and awarded Brazilian architect and designer Studio Arthur Casas.

verified_facts.text: Room interiors were designed by Studio Arthur Casas.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of them offer outstanding comfort and immaculate interiors designed by Studio Arthur Casas.

verified_facts.text: Traditional Croatian lace patterns appear in the rooms as wardrobe decoration.
verified_facts.excerpt: traditional Croatian lace patterns, which can be noticed in the rooms as a wardrobe decoration

verified_facts.text: The Villa Kolin Residence sits in a secluded part of the hotel, with private access through a small pine forest and a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: situated in a secluded part of the hotel, with private access through a small pine forest and a private pool.

verified_facts.text: The suites are named after old Dubrovnik expressions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Their names are derived from old Dubrovnik expressions to keep the spirit of the Old Town alive

verified_facts.text: The hotel displays works by local Croatian painters and sculptors such as Ivana Pegan, Dubravka Tullio and Ivo Dimnic.
verified_facts.excerpt: you will encounter and discover the works of local Croatian painters and sculptors, like Ivana Pegan, Dubravka Tullio, and Ivo Dimnić

verified_facts.text: The hotel's food and drink is made from locally sourced ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: We value food sustainability and everything we offer is made from locally sourced ingredients

verified_facts.text: Restaurant Pjerin serves breakfast, lunch and dinner on a glass terrace overlooking the Old Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: breakfast, lunch, and dinner served on a sleek glass terrace overlooking the Old Town.

verified_facts.text: Giardino Restaurant sits under century-old pines on an ancient stone terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Giardino Restaurant sits under century‑old pines on an ancient stone terrace

verified_facts.text: Galanto Bar is the hotel's rooftop bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Galanto Bar, Dubrovnik’s only rooftop bar

verified_facts.text: Libero Bar is an indoor bar for coffee, wine or a cocktail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Libero Bar is a serene and luxurious indoor hideaway, ideal for coffee, wine, or a cocktail.

verified_facts.text: Villa Spa treatments combine innovative techniques with Mediterranean natural remedies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in exclusive Villa SPA treatments performed with a combination of innovative techniques and Mediterranean natural remedies.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool with floor-to-ceiling windows facing the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: indoor pool with floor‑to‑ceiling windows opening to views of the ocean

verified_facts.text: The hotel's rocky cliffside beach has jumping platforms into the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rocky cliffside beach is a big hit for all ages, complete with jumping platforms into the sea

verified_facts.text: The Old Town is a 15-minute walk away, or a private transfer that is part of the hotel's service.
verified_facts.excerpt: 15-minute walk from the magic of the Old Town, or a quick private transfer (part of the hotel’s service)

verified_facts.text: Family suites have interconnecting rooms and balcony hot tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: spacious family suites featuring interconnecting rooms and balcony hot tubs

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a private sunrise tour of Mount Srd as one of the hotel's experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: You can take a private sunrise tour as part of Villa Dubrovnik’s experiences.

verified_facts.text: The beach is naturally rocky and not wheelchair accessible.
verified_facts.excerpt: The beach, however, remains untouched and naturally rocky as it is cliffside, so it’s not wheelchair accessible

verified_facts.text: The conference room holds up to 80 guests and can be divided into two sections.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our conference room welcomes up to 80 guests in an inviting environment that can be easily divided into two distinct sections

verified_facts.text: A traditional Mediterranean terrace with herbs was preserved on the seaside.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the seaside, the traditional Mediterranean terrace with herbs was preserved
